revision_history.note: First-author TRD. Key decisions: langgraph-checkpoint-postgres's PostgresSaver for checkpointing (decision-23, not hand-rolled persistence); 30s bounded timeout for external calls (decision-24, PTL choice); SSE via ag-ui-langgraph's add_langgraph_fastapi_endpoint (decision-25); one thin project-owned `requests` table for the Reviewer's pending-list query, LangGraph owns its own checkpoint internals (decision-26); LangGraph's built-in checkpoint history satisfies the trace-completeness budget instead of a custom audit table (decision-27). Full SQL DDL, JSON Schema API contracts, guarded state-transition table with side effects, and deployment substrate referencing architecture's env-local-dev/infra IDs (decision-11: no pipeline exists, confirmed unchanged by PTL). All 6 architecture components passed the deletion test unchanged; comp-chat-route/comp-review-route designed as real seams for the first time. 3 open questions flagged for TRD-time follow-up (retention policy, decline-reason category set, an already_decided error scope addition beyond what BRD literally specified). Short hash: nehzyHrgss.

Short hash: 3EjNpGw1qB.

Added a paragraph to Architecture Overview making explicit what the boundary fields only implied: comp-planner/comp-query-tool/comp-calc-agent/comp-synthesizer are LangGraph nodes (functions that run), while comp-orchestrator is the StateGraph structure itself (edges/routing, not a node) and comp-checkpoint-store is the attached PostgresSaver, not a step in the sequence. Also ties this to the Request Lifecycle: one state for the whole Request, not one per node. Short hash: YcHaGgrqrh.

Added decision-29 (PTL's explicit choice): comp-calc-agent's tool-calling loop (sum/average/percentage_change, chained for ratios) is built with deepagents.create_deep_agent() (0.4.11, verified against PyPI: needs langchain>=1.3.18 — tighter than ag-ui-langgraph's floor, so this becomes the project's effective langchain floor; langchain-google-genai>=4.3.7, satisfied by the 4.4.0 already pinned for decision-28), not a hand-built StateGraph+ToolNode subgraph. A lighter-weight hand-built alternative was proposed and is recorded in the decision's alternatives for the record. Registered directly as the node (not wrapped in a manual .invoke() call) so it shares the parent's PostgresSaver checkpointer rather than needing its own — noted in both Technology Choices and Persistence Constraints. Short hash: mgvLheEJm3.
